summary: Definitive resolution of the character record 'level' field offset. Confirmed level is at record +0x24 (BSS abs 0x440c), NOT +0x18. The values [8,9,5,4,4,2] previously labeled 'level' are hp_cur at +0x18 (BSS abs 0x4400). All 6 stock party members start at level 1.

findings.claim: Level field is at record offset +0x24 (BSS abs 0x440c). The stats panel renderer pushes this value to display_number.

evidence.details: FFB70C44  push word [bx+0x440c] — pushed as argument to display_number (call 0xc041) in the character view stats panel renderer. bx = slot_num * 0x1b0; abs 0x440c = BSS base 0x43e8 + +0x24.

findings.claim: Level field is at record offset +0x24. level_up_apply increments it with INC WORD.

evidence.details: FF070C44  inc word [bx+0x440c] — level increment on level-up. Preceded at 0xb226 by: mov ax, 0x1b0; imul [bp+0x8] (slot * stride), confirming bx = slot_num * 0x1b0.

findings.claim: Level field is at record offset +0x24. class_change_apply resets it to 1.

evidence.details: C7070C44 0100  mov word [bx+0x440c], 0x1 — level reset to 1 on class change. Same function (class_change_apply, image 0x6054) also writes saved_old_level at [bx+0x4597] (+0x1af).

findings.claim: hp_cur is at record offset +0x18 (BSS abs 0x4400), NOT the level field. Stock values are [8,9,5,4,4,2].

evidence.details: fn-party-row-render passes abs 0x4400 (BSS +0x18) to the HP-bar draw function. The party-row HP bar draws from [bx+0x4400]/[bx+0x4402]. Values in pcfile.dbs at record +0x18 are 08 00 (THESUS), 09 00 (TEMPEST), 05 00 (LYSANDR), 04 00 (NOBAL), 04 00 (TREON), 02 00 (PENTAG) — consistent with level-1 HP, not with expected levels 8/9/5/4/4/2.

findings.claim: sp_cur is at record offset +0x1c (BSS abs 0x4404). Stock values are 126/123/87/75/102/90.

evidence.details: fn-party-row-render passes abs 0x4404 (BSS +0x1c) to the SP-bar draw function. These are the values previously labeled hp_cur at the wrong offset +0x1c.

findings.claim: pcfile.dbs on-disk record bytes are copied 1:1 to BSS at the same relative offsets. No transformation.

evidence.details: F3A5  rep movsw — 0xd8 words (432 bytes) straight from file buffer [bp-0x1f8] to BSS at 0x43e8 + slot_index * 0x1b0. si = start of record buffer (no offset added), di = BSS slot base. Therefore disk[+N] == BSS[+N] for all N.

findings.claim: All 6 stock party members (THESUS..PENTAG) are level 1 in pcfile.dbs.

evidence.details: After 24-byte file header, bytes at offset 24+N*432+0x24 for N=0..5: all read as 0x0001 (u16 LE). Previously decoded as levels [8,9,5,4,4,2] because the decoder was reading from +0x18 instead of +0x24.

findings.claim: The previous 'empirical correction' in character-record.ts that moved level to +0x18 was based on misidentified HP data.

evidence.details: The wpcvw-naming-pass.json bss_layout (built with a 12-byte name assumption) originally claimed level at +0x24 (abs 0x440c). A subsequent 'empirical correction' moved it to +0x18 after observing values [8,9,5,4,4,2] there and interpreting them as plausible levels. Those values are actually hp_cur — small HP values for brand-new level-1 characters with ~8-9 max HP (STR+VIT-based). The engine ASM unambiguously confirms +0x24 is the level field via three independent sites.
